# Opsly
> Fractional Revenue Operations for scaling B2B teams. Founded by Ayobami Kehinde.

Opsly is a fractional RevOps consultancy that helps scaling B2B teams fix the gap between revenue generation and the operational systems underneath. Founded by Ayobami Kehinde, a revenue operations specialist with a background in software engineering and AI automation.

## Core expertise
- Revenue Operations (RevOps) strategy and implementation
- Pipeline visibility and deal tracking
- CRM optimisation and data governance
- AI automation for revenue teams (voice agents, lead follow-up, deal monitoring)
- Sales forecasting and attribution

## Services
- Diagnostic revenue audits
- Five-layer system installation (operating, trust, signal, continuity, visibility)
- CRM implementation and cleanup
- AI automation buildouts
- Fractional RevOps retainer

## Key facts
- £200k+ revenue recovered for a single client
- 3-4 deals per month recovered through system fixes
- 30% of stale deals successfully re-engaged
- Leads contacted within 5 minutes are 21x more likely to qualify
- Pricing: £1,500 to £5,000 typical project range
- Methodology: diagnosis first, build second — no obligation to continue after diagnostic

## Founder
Ayobami Kehinde — software engineer turned revenue operations specialist. Certified in HubSpot Revenue Operations, Salesforce Admin, and Salesforce Associate. Background at the intersection of software engineering, sales operations, and AI automation.
